From drawings
to project delivery.

My architectural background taught me to work through the details. Five years of design and site coordination in India brought those details into construction: reviewing drawings with site teams, coordinating materials and work sequencing, and managing residential and interior project execution.

At Arizona State University, I’m building on that experience through an M.S. in Construction Management & Technology. My next step is a Project/Field Engineer or Assistant Project Manager role, with estimating and procurement as supporting strengths.

Bridging design, field execution, and emerging technology to build smarter.
